blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Every text classifier for an African language begins with a budgeting question: how many labelled examples are needed, and can labels from other African languages stand in for them? We answer both questions empirically for 28 language-task pairs, news topic classification in 16 languages (MasakhaNEWS) and tweet sentiment in 12 languages (AfriSenti), using a character n-gram linear model that trains in seconds on two CPU cores with no pretrained weights and no accelerator. Monolingual learning curves at budgets from 25 to several thousand labels show that topic classification reaches 90% of its full-data macro-F1 with about 400 labels in the median language, while sentiment is still improving at the full training size in 11 of 12 languages and needs thousands of labels. Pooling the full training data of the other languages in the benchmark is worth a great deal at small budgets and nothing at large ones: at 25 target labels it adds 0.20 macro-F1 on average for news (up to 0.43 for Lingala) and 0.08 for sentiment, the gain decays to zero by 800 labels, and at full size pooling hurts in 9 of 16 and 8 of 12 languages. Twenty-five target labels plus pooled data match what 100 to 400 monolingual labels achieve for most news languages. A complete zero-shot transfer matrix shows that transfer without any target labels recovers a median of only 13% (news) and 4% (sentiment) of the gap between a majority-class predictor and the in-language model, with the exceptions explained by shared script (Amharic and Tigrinya), shared lexicon (English and Nigerian Pidgin, the Arabic dialects), or a shared label prior rather than by language family. We release code that regenerates every number from the public benchmark files and translate the results into concrete annotation guidance for teams building African-language classifiers without GPUs.
blocks.zh: 每个非洲语言的文本分类器都首先提出一个预算问题:需要多少标注的例子,其他非洲语言的标注可以代表它们吗? 我们用经验来回答28个语言任务对,16种语言的新闻主题分类(MasakhaneWS)和12种语言的推特情绪(AfriSenti)这两个问题,使用一个字符ng线性模型,在两个CPU核心上进行几秒钟的训练,没有预先训练的重量和加速器. 单语学习曲线在预算从25到几千个标签显示,主题分类达到了其全数据宏-F1的90%,中位语言的标签约为400个,而情绪在12种语言中的11种完全训练规模上仍在改善,需要数千个标签. 将其他语言的全部培训数据集中到基准中,对于小型预算来说是值很多的,而对于大型预算来说是值很多的:在25个目标标签中,平均为新闻增加0.20 宏-F1(林加拉最多0.43),情绪增加0.08,增益衰减为零800个标签,在全尺寸的集合中,12种语言中的9种和8种伤害. 25个目标标签加上集合数据,匹配了100到400个单一语言标签为大多数新闻语言所实现的目标标签. 一个完整的零镜头传输矩阵显示,没有任何目标标签的传输只回收了占多数级预测器与语言模型之间差距的13%(新闻)和4%(sentiment)的中位数,只有共享脚本(Amharic and Tigrinya),共享词典(英语和尼日利亚语,阿拉伯语方言),或共享标签之前而不是语言家族所解释的例外. 我们发布代码,从公共基准文件中重新生成每个数字,并将结果转化为具体注释指导,用于团队建设没有GPU的非洲语分类器.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Every text classifier for an African language starts with the same question: how many labelled examples do we need? The answer decides whether a newsroom, a health hotline, or a moderation team can afford to build the system at all. Annotation is the dominant cost of African-language NLP. It is paid by native speakers whose time is scarce, and it is paid again for every new language and every new task. Yet the question is rarely answered directly. Benchmark papers report performance at the full training size they happened to collect, and few-shot studies report performance at a handful of examples with large pretrained models that most deployments cannot run. Between those two points, where real projects live, there is little guidance.
blocks.zh: 非洲语言的每个文本分类器都从同一个问题开始:我们需要多少标签上的例子? 答案决定新闻室、健康热线或温和小组是否有能力建造这个系统。 注释是非洲语言NLP的主要成本. 它由讲母语的人支付,他们的时间不多,而且每一新语言和每一新任务都要支付。 然而,这个问题很少得到直接回答。 基准文件以所收集的全部培训规模报告业绩,少数研究则以少数例子报告业绩,这些例子具有大多数部署无法运行的经过预先训练的大型模式。 在这两个要点之间,真正的项目所在,几乎没有指导。

blocks.en: This paper measures the answer for 28 language-task pairs across two public benchmarks, MasakhaNEWS ( Adelani et al., 2023 ) for news topic classification in 16 languages and AfriSenti ( Muhammad et al., 2023a ; Muhammad et al., 2023b ) for tweet sentiment in 12 languages. We train a single, deliberately simple model family, character n-gram TF-IDF with a linear support vector machine, at annotation budgets from 25 to several thousand labelled examples per language, and we record macro-F1 at every budget. The model needs no accelerator and no pretrained weights. It trains in seconds on a laptop, which is the compute that most African deployments actually have ( Ahia et al., 2021 ; Leong et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 本文衡量了横跨MasakhaneWS(Adelani等人,2023年)和AfriSenti(Muhammad等人,2023年a;Muhammad等人,2023年b)两种公共基准的28种语言任务组合的答案。 我们用线性支持矢量机训练一个单一的,刻意简单的模型家族,字符n-gm的TF-IDF,在注释预算上从每个语言的25到几千个标注的例子,我们在每个预算中记录宏观-F1. 该型号不需要加速器,也不需要预先训练的重量. Ahia等人,2021年;Leong等人,2023年。

blocks.en: We then ask the second question that every project with a small budget asks: can labelled data from other African languages substitute for labels in ours? We measure this two ways. Pooling adds the full training data of all other languages in the benchmark to the target language’s small budget and trains one shared model. Zero-shot transfer trains on one language and tests on another, for every ordered pair, giving a transfer matrix across scripts and language families. Both are cheap to run and both are the kind of thing a team would try before spending money on annotation.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们问第二个问题,每个预算较少的项目都问:其他非洲语言的标注数据能否代替我们的标注数据? 我们用两种方法衡量。 " 集合 " 将所有其他语文的全部培训数据纳入目标语文的小额预算,并培训一个共享模式。 一种语言的零射转动列车和另一种语言的测试,每对订购的对,给出跨脚本和语言家族的转动矩阵. 两者都低廉的运行 而且两者都是团队在花钱做笔记前会尝试的

blocks.en: The findings are practical. For news topic classification, a few hundred labels in the target language are enough for a simple model to reach most of its full-data performance, and pooling the other languages’ data lets a team start with a few dozen. For sentiment, no budget in the benchmark range is enough, pooling helps only the smallest budgets, and at full size it hurts most languages. Zero-shot transfer between African languages, the cheapest option of all, mostly does not work, and where it appears to work the reason is shared script, shared vocabulary, or a shared label distribution rather than linguistic relatedness.
blocks.zh: 调查结果是切合实际的。 对于新闻主题分类,目标语言的几百个标签足以让一个简单的模型达到其大部分的完整数据性能,集合其他语言的数据让一个团队从几十个开始. 就情感而言,基准范围内的预算都不够,集中起来只有助于最小的预算,在全部规模下,它伤害大多数语言. 非洲语言之间的零镜头传输,是所有语言中最便宜的选择,但大多不起作用,在似乎起作用的地方,原因是共享脚本,共享词汇,或共享标签分布,而不是语言关联.

blocks.en: Our contributions are a set of measured learning curves for 28 African-language classification tasks under a compute budget any team can meet, a per-language estimate of the label budget at which a simple model reaches most of its full-data performance, a controlled measurement of when pooling other African languages’ data helps and when it hurts, a complete zero-shot transfer matrix that separates script sharing from genuine linguistic transfer, and a release of code that regenerates every number from the public benchmark files.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是在计算预算下任何团队都能满足的28个非洲语言分类任务的一套测量学习曲线,一个简单的模型达到其大部分完整数据性能的标签预算的每个语言估计,一个控制性地衡量集合其他非洲语言数据帮助和伤害时,一个将脚本共享与真正的语言转移区分开的完整的零镜头传输矩阵,以及从公共基准文件中重新生成每个数字的代码的发布.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Community efforts, most visibly Masakhane ( Nekoto et al., 2020 ) , have produced benchmark datasets for named entity recognition ( Adelani et al., 2021 ) , news topic classification ( Adelani et al., 2023 ) , and sentiment ( Muhammad et al., 2023a ) , and pretrained encoders adapted to African languages such as AfriBERTa ( Ogueji et al., 2021 ) and AfroXLMR ( Alabi et al., 2022 ) , built on XLM-R ( Conneau et al., 2020 ) . These papers report strong results at full training size. The MasakhaNEWS paper also reports few-shot results with pattern-exploiting training ( Schick and Schütze, 2021 ) , reaching about 93% of full-supervision performance with ten examples per label, which is an important data point but one that requires a large pretrained model and GPU fine-tuning. Joshi et al. (2020) and Adebara and Abdul-Mageed (2022) document how little of NLP reaches African languages, and Kreutzer et al. (2022) show that the web-crawled data behind multilingual pretraining is often unusable for exactly these languages.
blocks.zh: 社区努力,最显著的Masakhane(Nekoto等人,2020年),为命名实体的识别(Adelani等人,2021年),新闻专题分类(Adelani等人,2023年)和情感(Muhammad等人,2023年a年)编制了基准数据集,并根据非洲语言(AfriBERTa(Ogueji等人,2021年)和AfroXLMR(Alabi等人,2022年)等进行预训编码,这些编码建立在XLM-R(Conneau等人,2020年)之上。 这些文件报告在全面培训规模上取得了显著成果。 MasakhanEWS的论文也报道了一些以模式探索训练(Schick和Schütze,2021年)的拍摄结果,达到全监督性能的93%左右,每个标签有10个实例,这是一个重要的数据点,但需要大型的预先训练模型和GPU微调. Joshi等人(2020年)和Adebara和Abdul-Mageed(2022年)记录了NLP如何很少到达非洲语言,Kreutzer等人(2022年)表明,多语种预训背后的网络编译数据往往无法完全用于这些语言.

blocks.en: Ahia et al. (2021) name the low-resource double bind: the languages with the least data are also served by the communities with the least compute, so methods that assume large models compound the disadvantage. Leong et al. (2023) evaluate low-compute adaptation methods on African languages and find that simple approaches remain competitive. Hooker (2021) and Schwartz et al. (2020) make the general case for reporting cost. Character n-gram models ( Cavnar and Trenkle, 1994 ) and linear classifiers over sparse features ( Joulin et al., 2017 ) are the standard low-compute baseline; we use them because they are what a team without a GPU will use, and because their learning curves are easy to interpret.
blocks.zh: Ahia等人(2021年)将低资源双联结命名为: 数据最少的语言也由计算最少的社区服务,因此假设大模型的方法使缺点更加复杂. Leong等人(2023年)评价非洲语言的低计算适应方法,发现简单方法仍然具有竞争力。 Hooker (2021)和Schwartz等人 (2020)为报告成本提供了一般性的理由。 字符n-gram模型(Cavnar and Trenkle,1994年)和线性分类器在稀疏特征之上(Joulin等人,2017年)是标准低计算基准;我们使用它们是因为它们是没有GPU的团队会使用的东西,也因为他们的学习曲线容易解释.

blocks.en: Sample-size planning through learning curves has a long history in applied classification ( Figueroa et al., 2012 ) , and active learning ( Settles, 2009 ) exists to reduce the budget further. In multilingual NLP, Lauscher et al. (2020) show that zero-shot transfer from multilingual transformers degrades sharply for distant, low-resource target languages, and that a few target labels recover most of the loss. Hedderich et al. (2020) study transfer and distant supervision for Hausa and Yorùbá and find that small amounts of target data matter more than the transfer source. Lin et al. (2019) learn to rank transfer languages from linguistic and dataset features. Hu et al. (2020) standardise cross-lingual evaluation for high-resource models. Our study is the low-compute complement to this line: no pretrained model, no GPU, and an explicit account of the label budget in each language.
blocks.zh: 通过学习曲线的样本规模规划在应用分类方面有着悠久的历史(Figueroa等人,2012年),积极学习(Solms,2009年)的存在是为了进一步削减预算. 在多语种的NLP中,Lauscher等人(2020年)显示,从多语种变速器中零发转速对远近,资源低的目标语言急剧降解,少数目标标签恢复了大部分损失. Hedderich等人(2020年)研究Hausa和Yorúbá的转移和远程监管,发现少量目标数据比转移源更重要. 林等编. (2019年)学习从语言和数据集特征中分级转录语言. Hu等人(2020年)将高资源模型的跨文化评价标准化. 我们的研究是对这行的低计算补充:没有经过预先训练的模型,没有GPU,并且明确说明每种语言的标签预算.

blocks.en: 3 Setup
blocks.zh: 3 设置

blocks.en: MasakhaNEWS ( Adelani et al., 2023 ) covers Amharic, English, French, Hausa, Igbo, Lingala, Luganda, Oromo, Nigerian Pidgin, Rundi, chiShona, Somali, Swahili, Tigrinya, isiXhosa, and Yorùbá, with four to seven topic labels per language. Label sets differ across languages: Amharic has four topics, Hausa seven. Training sets range from 608 (Lingala) to 3,309 (English) articles. We classify the headline concatenated with the first 1,000 characters of the body. AfriSenti ( Muhammad et al., 2023a ) covers the 12 languages of the SemEval-2023 Task 12 monolingual track (Algerian Arabic, Amharic, Hausa, Igbo, Kinyarwanda, Moroccan Arabic, Mozambican Portuguese, Nigerian Pidgin, Swahili, Xitsonga, Twi, Yorùbá) with three sentiment labels; training sets range from 804 (Xitsonga) to 14,172 (Hausa) tweets. We use the official train and test splits as distributed in the benchmark repositories and report macro-F1, the metric both benchmarks use, on the official test split.
blocks.zh: 马萨卡尼瓦斯 (Adelani等人,2023年)涵盖阿姆哈拉语,英语,法语,豪萨语,伊格博语,林加拉语,卢干达语,奥罗莫语,尼日利亚皮德金语,伦迪语,奇肖纳语,索马里语,斯瓦希里语,提格里尼亚语,伊西克斯霍萨语,以及约鲁巴语,每种语言有4-7个主题标签. 不同语言的标签集不同: 阿姆哈拉语有四个主题,豪萨七. 训练集从608集(林加拉语)到3,309集(英语)的文章. 我们把头条缩合 与身体的前1000个字符。 AfriSenti(Muhammad等人,2023年a)涵盖SemEval-2023任务12种单一语言的12种语言(阿尔及利亚阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语、豪萨语、伊格博语、基尼亚卢旺达语、摩洛哥阿拉伯语、莫桑比克葡萄牙语、尼日利亚皮德金语、斯瓦希里语、西松加语、Twi语、约鲁巴语),并有三种情感标签;培训内容从804种(西松加语)到14 172种(豪萨语)微博。 我们使用在基准储存库中分配的官方列车和测试分数,并在官方测试分数上报告宏观-F1,即两个基准的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Character n-grams of length 2 to 5 within word boundaries, TF-IDF weighted with sublinear term frequency and capped at 200,000 features, followed by a linear support vector machine ( C = 0.5 C=0.5 ) from scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al., 2011 ) . Character n-grams handle the Ge’ez, Arabic, and Latin scripts in the data without any tokeniser, normaliser, or language-specific resource, which is what makes the same pipeline usable for every language. The vectoriser is fit on whatever training data the configuration uses, so a 25-example run sees only those 25 examples.
blocks.zh: 长度2至5的字符n-gm在词边界内,TF-IDF以次线性术语频率加权,封顶于20万个特性,之后是来自scikit-learn的线性支持矢量机(C=0.5 C=0.5)(Pedregosa等人,2011年). 字符 n-gram 处理数据中的 Ge ' ez 、 阿拉伯语和拉丁字母, 而没有任何符号化、 正常化或语言专用资源, 这使得同一管道可用于每种语言 。 矢量器适合配置所使用的任何训练数据,因此25例运行只看到这25例.

blocks.en: For each language we draw stratified subsamples of the official training set at budgets n ∈ { 25 , 50 , 100 , 200 , 400 , 800 } n\in\{25,50,100,200,400,800\} and also use the full training set. Each budget below the full size is drawn with three random seeds. Two settings are trained at every budget. Monolingual trains on the n n target-language examples alone. Pooled trains on the same n n examples together with the full training sets of every other language in the benchmark, with no language tag and no reweighting; the vectoriser is fit on the other languages’ data and applied to the target examples. We also train the pooled model with zero target examples, which is the multilingual zero-shot setting. For the transfer matrix we train on the full training set of each source language and test on the official test set of every target language in the same benchmark. Predictions of labels that do not exist in a target language count as errors. Every run records wall-clock training time and the size of the weight matrix, all on two CPU cores with no accelerator.
blocks.zh: 对于每种语言,我们为预算{{{25、50、100、200、400、800}}{{{{{}中正式培训的分层样本}25、50、100、200、800}也使用全套培训。 完全尺寸以下的每个预算都以三个随机种子抽取. 每个预算都培训两个环境。 单在nn目标语言实例上的单语列车. 同一n n 实例的集成列车,以及基准中所有其他语言的全套培训,没有语言标记,也没有重新加权;矢量器适合其他语言的数据,适用于目标实例. 我们还以零目标实例培训集合模型,即多语种零射设定。 对于转移矩阵,我们对每种源语言进行全套培训,并对同一基准的每种目标语言进行正式测试。 目标语言中不存在的标签的预测值计为错误. 每次运行都记录了壁时训练时间和重量矩阵的大小,都记录在两个没有加速器的CPU核心上.

blocks.en: Following Figueroa et al. (2012) we fit an inverse power law F ⁡ ( n ) = a − b ​ n − c F(n)=a-b\,n^{-c} to each monolingual learning curve and report n 95 n_{95} , the smallest budget at which the fitted curve reaches 95% of the full-data macro-F1. We also report the raw budget at which the measured mean first reaches that level, which needs no model.
blocks.zh: 继Figueroa等人(2012年)之后,我们在每个单一语言的学习曲线上采用了反向权力法F → (n) = a → b n → c F(n) = a- b\ b\,n^{-c),并报告n 95 n_{95},这是最小的预算,在其中,适合曲线达到全数据宏F1的95%. 我们还报告所计量的平均数首先达到这一水平的原始预算,这不需要任何模式。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Monolingual learning curves and label budgets
blocks.zh: 4.1 单一语言学习曲线和标签预算

blocks.en: Figure 1: MasakhaNEWS learning curves. Macro-F1 on the official test split against the number of labelled target-language training examples (log scale), for a model trained on those examples alone (monolingual) and for one trained on those examples plus the full training sets of the other 15 languages (pooled). Bars are ± 1 \pm 1 standard deviation over three subsamples. The dotted line is the pooled model with zero target examples.

blocks.en: Figure 2: AfriSenti learning curves, same layout as Figure 1 . Sentiment is far from saturated at the full training size in every language except Amharic, whose curve is dominated by a train-test label shift (52% neutral in training, 67% negative in test).
blocks.zh: 图2: AfriSenti学习曲线,布局与图1相同. 除阿姆哈拉语外,每一种语言的全训练尺寸的感官都远非饱和,其曲线以列车测试标签转换为主(52%在训练中中立,67%在试验中负).

blocks.en: Figures 1 and 2 show the monolingual curves, and Table 1 gives the numbers. For news topic classification the curves rise steeply and then flatten. With 100 labels the monolingual model reaches on average 72% of its full-data macro-F1; with 400 labels it reaches 90%. The raw budget at which a language first reaches 95% of its full-data score, n 95 n_{95} , ranges from 200 (chiShona) to the full training set (Tigrinya, Oromo, Rundi, Lingala, and Luganda, whose curves are still rising), with a median of 800. The fitted power law gives a median n 95 n_{95} of 575 and puts most languages between 400 and 900. These are budgets a small team can meet: a native-speaking annotator labelling news headlines and leads at a few per minute produces 500 labels in a working day.
blocks.zh: 图1和图2显示了单一语言曲线,表1列出了数字。 就新闻主题分类而言,曲线陡然上升,然后变平。 单语模式有100个标签,平均达到其全数据宏-F1的72%;有400个标签,达到90%。 一个语言首次达到全数据分数95%的原始预算n 95n_{95},从200(chishona)到全训练集(Tigrinya, Oromo, Rundi, Lingala, 和Luganda, 其曲线仍在上升),中间数为800. 装配的动力法给出的中位数n 95 n_{95}为575种,大多数语言在400-900之间. 这些预算是小团队可以满足的:一个讲本地语的注目记者,

blocks.en: Sentiment is a different problem. With 100 labels the monolingual model reaches 63% of its full-data score and with 400 labels 78%, but the full-data score itself is low (0.40 to 0.79 macro-F1) and the curves have not flattened. In 11 of 12 languages the raw n 95 n_{95} is the full training set, and the fitted estimates range from about 700 (Xitsonga) to 8,000 (Amharic) with a median near 2,300. Sentiment on short, noisy, code-switched social-media text needs an order of magnitude more labels than news topic classification, and a character n-gram model may never close the gap; this is where pretrained representations earn their compute. The Amharic curve also shows a hazard that budget planning must account for: the training and test label distributions differ sharply (52% neutral in training against 67% negative in test), so a small model that learns the training prior scores near zero on the test set until it has seen enough data to learn actual sentiment cues.
blocks.zh: 感应是另一个问题。 单语模式有100个标签,达到其全数据分数的63%,有400个标签的78%,但全数据分数本身较低(0.40到0.79宏F1),曲线没有平整. 在12种语言中的11种语言中,原始n 95 n_{95}是完整的培训集,匹配的估计数从大约700种(Xitsonga)到8 000种(Amharic)不等,中位数接近2 300。 在短短,吵闹,代码切换的社交媒体文本上的感应需要比新闻话题分类更需要数量级的标签,一个字符n-gram模型可能永远无法弥补差距;这就是预先训练过的表达方式赚取计算额的地方. 阿姆哈拉曲线也表明预算规划必须说明一个危险:培训和测试标签分布差异很大(52%在培训中中性,67%在测试中负性),因此一个小型模型在测试集上学习培训前的分数接近0,直到它看到足够的数据来学习实际的情绪提示.

blocks.en: Table 1: Macro-F1 on the official test split. n n is the full training size. zero is the pooled model with no target labels; m and p are the monolingual and pooled models at 100 and 400 target labels; full is the model trained on all target labels, alone or pooled. n 95 n_{95} is the smallest budget at which the monolingual model reaches 95% of its full-data score, measured (raw) and from a fitted power law (fit); a raw value equal to n n means the curve had not flattened.
blocks.zh: 表1:官方测试拆分的宏-F1. n是训练的全部大小。 0是没有目标标签的集合模型;m和p是100和400目标标签的单语和集合模型;完整是在所有目标标签上训练过的模型,单独或集合. n 95 n_{95}是单语模型达到其全数据分数的95%的最小预算,测量(raw)和从适配的功率定律(fit);一个等于n的原始值表示曲线没有平整.

blocks.en: 4.2 Pooling other languages: large gains at small budgets, none at large ones
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 汇集其他语文:在小额预算中取得巨大收益,在一般预算中没有收益

blocks.en: Figure 3: Gain from pooling, pooled minus monolingual macro-F1, as a function of the target-language budget. Thin lines are languages; the thick line is the mean. Pooling is worth about 0.20 macro-F1 at 25 news labels and 0.08 at 25 sentiment labels, and nothing by 800.
blocks.zh: 图3:集合、集合减单一语言宏观F1所产生的收益,作为目标语文预算的一项职能。 细线为语言;粗线为正线. Pooling在25个新闻标签上值约0.20 macro-F1,在25个情绪标签上值约0.08,在800个没有.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows the difference between the pooled and monolingual curves. At 25 target labels, pooling the other languages’ training data raises news macro-F1 by 0.20 on average and by more than 0.35 for Lingala, Luganda, and Nigerian Pidgin; it helps 15 of 16 languages. The gain halves at every doubling of the budget: 0.14 at 50 labels, 0.09 at 100, 0.05 at 200, 0.03 at 400, and 0.004 at 800, where pooling helps only 6 of 16 languages. At the full training size pooling is a wash on average and hurts 9 of 16 languages, by up to 0.05 (isiXhosa) and 0.03 to 0.04 (Amharic, Hausa). The same shape appears for sentiment with smaller amplitude: 0.08 at 25 labels, helping 9 of 12 languages, decaying to zero by 800, and at full size hurting 8 of 12 languages, by as much as 0.10 for Amharic.
blocks.zh: 图3显示集合曲线和单一语言曲线之间的差异。 在25个目标标签上,汇集其他语言的培训数据平均能提高0.20分,林加拉语、卢干达语和尼日利亚语Pidgin语的新闻宏F1比0.35分多;它帮助了16种语言中的15种。 预算每翻一番,收益就会减半:50种标签为0.14,100为0.09,200为0.05,400为0.03,800为0.004,其中汇集16种语言中只有6种帮助。 在全部训练规模的集合中,平均是清洗,并伤害16种语言中的9种,最多0.05种(isiXhosa)和0.03至0.04种(Amharic,Hausa)。 用较小的振幅表示的情绪也会出现同样的形状:在25个标签上为0.08,帮助了12种语言中的9种,衰减到0乘800,全尺寸伤害了12种语言中的8种,对阿姆哈拉语来说高达0.10.

blocks.en: The practical reading is a label-equivalent. Twenty-five target labels plus pooled data match what the monolingual model achieves with 100 to 400 labels in 12 of 16 news languages, and with 50 labels for Amharic and Hausa (Table 1 ); for Nigerian Pidgin, pooled data with 25 labels already matches the full monolingual model, because English is in the pool. For sentiment the equivalent is smaller and less consistent, from 25 labels (no gain) for Hausa, Igbo, and Xitsonga to 800 for Algerian Arabic and Nigerian Pidgin, and the full set for Amharic. Pooling is therefore the right first step for a team with a few dozen labels and the wrong last step for a team with a few thousand, and the crossover is at a few hundred labels for both tasks.
blocks.zh: 实用读取是标签等同的. 25个目标标签加上集合数据,与16种新闻语言中12种语言的100至400个标签相匹配,与安哈里语和豪萨语的50个标签相匹配(表1);对于尼日利亚Pidgin,25个标签的集合数据已经与完全单一语言模式相匹配,因为英语在集合中. 对于情绪来说,其等效性较小,也不太一致,从豪萨、伊格博和希松加的25个标签(无收益)到阿尔及利亚阿拉伯语和尼日利亚语的800个,以及阿姆哈拉语的全套标签。 因此,集合是一支拥有几十个标签的球队的正确的第一步,也是一支拥有几千个标签的球队的错的最后一步,而交叉的球队两个任务都有几百个标签.

blocks.en: Why pooling stops helping is visible in the transfer matrix below. The shared model has to fit every language’s decision boundary with one weight vector over a shared character n-gram space; other languages’ data sets the boundary for n-grams the target language shares with them, which is helpful when the target has too few examples to set it itself and harmful once it does, because the other languages’ usage of those n-grams is not the target’s. The pooled model is also five times larger (11 MB against 2 MB of weights for news) and takes 50 seconds rather than 2 to train, which matters little on a laptop but is the wrong direction for a phone.
blocks.zh: 为什么集合停止帮助在下面的传输矩阵中可见. 共享的模型必须让每种语言的决定边界与一个重矢量在共享的字符 n-gm 空间上匹配;其他语言的数据为与它们共享的目标语言设定 n-gm 的边界,当目标没有太多的例子可以自行设定并且一旦设定就有害,这很有帮助,因为其他语言使用这些 n-g 的不是目标. 集合型号也是5倍大(11 MB对2 MB的重量新闻),训练需要50秒而不是2秒,这在笔记本电脑上不重要,但对电话来说是错误的方向.

blocks.en: 4.3 Zero-shot transfer: script and lexicon, not family
blocks.zh: 4.3 零镜头传输:脚本和词典,而非家族

blocks.en: Figure 4: Zero-shot transfer. A model trained on the row language’s full training set is tested on the column language. Cells show the fraction of the gap between a majority-class predictor and the column language’s own full-data model that the transferred model recovers, so 0 means no better than guessing the most common label and 1 means as good as in-language training. Languages are ordered by script and family: Ge’ez (amh, tir), Cushitic (som, orm), Nigerian languages (hau, yor, ibo, pcm), colonial languages (eng, fra), Bantu (swa, lin, lug, run, sna, xho); Arabic dialects (amh is Ge’ez), Nigerian, and Bantu for AfriSenti.
blocks.zh: 图4:零射转机. 在栏目语言上测试了在栏目语言的全套培训中培训的模型。 单元格显示一个多数级的预测器和列语言本身的全数据模型之间差距的一小部分,被转移的模型会恢复,所以0意味着不比猜测最常见的标签更好,1意味着与语言训练一样好. 语言按文字和家庭顺序排列:格日语(amh, tir),库希特语(som, orm),尼日利亚语(hau, yor, ibo, pcm),殖民地语(eng, fra),班图语(swa, lin, lug, run, sna, xho),阿拉伯语方言(amh is Geez),尼日利亚语,班图语为AfriSenti语.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the full transfer matrix. The typical off-diagonal cell recovers a median of 13% of the majority-to-own-model gap for news and 4% for sentiment; only 12% and 11% of the source-target pairs recover more than 40%. Zero-shot transfer between African languages with a surface-form model is, as a rule, close to useless. The exceptions are informative because each has a mechanism that is not linguistic relatedness. English to Nigerian Pidgin recovers 92% of the gap and Igbo to Pidgin 79%, because Pidgin is an English-lexified creole and the Nigerian news sources share named entities. Tigrinya to Amharic recovers 68% and Amharic to Tigrinya 60%, the only pair in the data sharing the Ge’ez script, so their character n-grams overlap heavily. Rundi to Lingala (69%) and Swahili to Rundi (68%) are Bantu pairs with shared loanwords and place names. For sentiment, the top pairs are Moroccan to Algerian Arabic (72%), the two Arabic-script dialects, and a cluster of sources that transfer to Amharic (Xitsonga 74%, Moroccan Arabic 73%, Nigerian Pidgin 65%) which is a label-prior artefact: those models predict negative for most Amharic tweets, and 67% of the Amharic test set is negative. Family membership on its own, for instance Hausa to Somali or Oromo (both Afroasiatic but different branches), buys nothing.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了全部转移矩阵。 典型的对角细胞为新闻恢复占多数至拥有模式差距的13%的中位数,为情绪恢复占4%的中位数;只有12%和11%的源目标对恢复超过40%. 带有表面形态模型的非洲语言之间的零射线传输通常接近于无用. 例外情况是翔实的,因为每个机制都有一个与语言无关的机制。 英文到尼日利亚的皮金恢复92%的缺口,伊格博恢复到皮金79%,因为皮金是英语语言化的克里奥尔语,尼日利亚新闻来源共享被命名的实体. Tigrinya至Amharic恢复了68%,Amharic恢复了Tigrinya60%,这是数据中唯一一对共享Ge'ez脚本的人,因此他们的性格n-gm重合. 伦迪至林加拉(69%)和斯瓦希里至伦迪(68%)是班图双人,拥有共享的借词和地名. 就情感而言,顶级对称是摩洛哥语至阿尔及利亚阿拉伯语(72%),两种阿拉伯语标语方言,以及一组向阿姆哈拉语(Xitsonga 74%,摩洛哥阿拉伯语73%,尼日利亚语Pidgin 65%)转移的源头,这是一种标签前的人工制品:这些模型预测大多数阿姆哈拉语的推文为负数,67%的阿姆哈拉语测试是负数。 家庭成员靠自己,例如豪萨到索马里或奥罗莫(都是非裔但不同分支),一无所获。

blocks.en: This matters for how teams choose a transfer source. The linguistic-similarity heuristics that work for pretrained multilingual encoders ( Lin et al., 2019 ) do not carry over to the surface-form models that run on a CPU. For these models the useful predictors are shared script, shared lexicon (colonial and creole relationships, dialect continua), and shared named entities from a shared news ecosystem, and the label prior must be checked before any transfer number is believed.
blocks.zh: 这关系到团队如何选择传输源. 为预训多语种编码器工作的语言-同义电流学(Lin等人,2019年)不会结转到运行在CPU上的表面形态模型. 对于这些模型,有用的预测器是共享脚本,共享词典(殖民地和克里奥尔关系,方言 continua),共享来自共享新闻生态系统的命名实体,在相信任何传输编号之前必须检查前面的标签.

blocks.en: 4.4 Cost
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 费用

blocks.en: The full monolingual model trains in 0.1 to 6 seconds per language and the pooled model in 18 to 53 seconds, on two CPU cores with 7 GB of memory. Scoring a test set of a few hundred to a few thousand documents takes under a second. Generating every number in this paper, 28 languages at seven budgets in two settings with three seeds plus the two transfer matrices, took about two and a half hours on the same two cores. No GPU, no pretrained model, and no external service were used at any point. We report this not as a limitation but as the operating point of the study: it is the compute that a newsroom, an NGO, or a university lab in most of Africa can rely on ( Ahia et al., 2021 ; Hooker, 2021 ) , and the learning curves above are the curves that compute produces.
blocks.zh: 完全单语模式列车以每语言0.1至6秒的速度运行,集合模式以18至53秒的速度运行在两个CPU核心上,内存为7GB. 一套几百到几千份文件的测试要花一秒钟时间。 在本文中每生成一个数字,28种语言在两种情况下的7种预算中加上3种种子加上两个转录矩阵,在同一个两个核心上用了大约两个半小时. 没有GPU,没有经过预先训练的型号,也没有使用任何外部服务. 我们将此报告不是作为限制,而是作为研究的操作点:非洲大多数地区的新闻室、非政府组织或大学实验室可以依赖的计算(Ahia等人,2021年;Hooker,2021年),上面的学习曲线是计算产生的曲线。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results translate into budgets. For a news-style topic task, plan on 400 to 800 labels per language for a simple model to reach 90% to 95% of what it will ever do, and start with pooled data from any other African-language news corpus with the same label scheme, which makes the first 25 to 100 labels worth several times their count. Drop the pooled data once the target budget passes a few hundred labels, since it then costs accuracy as well as compute. For sentiment on social media, do not expect a character n-gram model to be good at any budget; plan on thousands of labels, treat pooling as a small early boost only, and expect to move to a pretrained encoder ( Alabi et al., 2022 ; Ogueji et al., 2021 ) once labels exist. Before using any transfer source, check its label prior against the target’s, because a model that recovers 70% of the gap on paper may be doing nothing more than predicting the majority class.
blocks.zh: 结果转化为预算。 对于一个新闻风格的话题任务,计划每个语言的400到800个标签,一个简单的模型可以达到它所将完成的90%到95%,并且从其他非洲语新闻的集合数据开始,并且有同样的标签计划,这使得前25到100个标签的价值是它们的数倍。 一旦目标预算通过几百个标签,就放弃集合数据,因为这样既要计算准确性,又要计算准确性。 对于社交媒体上的情绪,不要期望角色n-gram模型擅长任何预算;计划上千个标签,只把集合作为小的早期推动,并期望一旦标签存在就转移到一个事先训练好的编码器(Alabi等人,2022年;Ogueji等人,2021年). 在使用任何转移源之前,先检查其标签与目标标签,因为一个恢复70%纸面差距的模型可能只是预测多数阶层。

blocks.en: Macro-F1 on the official test split is one number per language, and the official splits carry their own histories: the Amharic AfriSenti shift shows that a test set can differ from its training set in ways that dominate a small model’s score. Three subsamples per budget give error bars but not a full picture of variance at 25 labels, where a single unlucky draw can miss a class entirely. We used one model family, chosen because it is what runs without a GPU; a pretrained encoder would shift every curve up and, from the evidence in Adelani et al. (2023) , would flatten the news curves much earlier. We did not study active learning ( Settles, 2009 ) , which could reduce the budgets we report, nor distant supervision ( Hedderich et al., 2020 ) . The pooled setting mixes languages without weighting; language-tagged or upweighted variants might extend the range over which pooling helps.
blocks.zh: 官方测试分数上的Macro-F1是每个语言一个数字,官方的分数带有他们自己的历史: Amharic AfriSenti的变迁表明,一个测试集可以以支配一个小模型分数的方式与其训练集不同. 每个预算有3个子样本给出错误条,但不能在25个标签上完整地显示差异,其中单个不幸运的画可以完全错过一个类. 我们使用了一个模型家族, 因为它是运行 没有GPU; 预先训练的编码器会让每个曲线向上移动, 我们没有研究积极的学习(Setters,2009年),这可能会减少我们报告的预算,也没有研究遥远的监督(Hedderich等人,2020年)。 集合设置在不加权的情况下混合语言;语言标记或加权增加的变体可能扩大集合帮助的范围。

blocks.en: Our curves agree with Lauscher et al. (2020) and Hedderich et al. (2020) that a few target labels are worth more than any transfer source, and extend the finding to a regime those papers do not cover: no pretrained model at all. The MasakhaNEWS few-shot result, about 93% of full performance from ten examples per label with a large model and pattern-exploiting training, sits at the same 90% mark that our simple model reaches with 400 labels. The choice between the two is a choice between 40 labels and a GPU or 400 labels and a laptop, and for most African deployments the second is the one that exists.
blocks.zh: 我们的曲线同意Lauscher等人(2020年)和Hedderich等人(2020年)的观点,认为一些目标标签比任何转移来源都值钱,并将发现扩大到那些文件没有覆盖的政权:完全没有经过预先训练的模式。 MasakhANEWS的微博结果, 大约93%的完整性能, 两者的选择是40个标签和一个GPU或400个标签和一个笔记本电脑之间的选择,对于大多数非洲部署来说,第二个是存在的一个.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Across 28 African-language classification tasks, a character n-gram linear model with no pretrained weights reaches most of its full-data performance with a few hundred labels for news topics and needs thousands for tweet sentiment. Pooling the training data of other African languages is worth up to 0.4 macro-F1 when the target has a few dozen labels and costs accuracy once it has a few hundred, with the crossover at a few hundred labels in both tasks. Zero-shot transfer without target labels recovers little of the in-language performance except where languages share a script, a lexicon, or a label prior. All of it runs on two CPU cores in an afternoon, and all of it can be regenerated from the public benchmark files with the released code. The numbers are the budget a team should plan for, measured under the compute that team has.
blocks.zh: 在28个非洲语分类任务中,一个没有预先训练权重的字符n-gm线性模型达到了其全部数据性能的大部分,有几百个用于新闻主题的标签,需要数千个用于推特情绪. 汇集其他非洲语言的培训数据值高达0.4 宏-F1,如果目标有几十个标签,一旦有几百个标签,则其费用准确性将达到0.4 ,而交叉数据在这两项任务中都有几百个标签。 没有目标标签的零射转录,除了语言共享一个脚本,一个词典,或者一个标签之前,几乎没有恢复语言中的性能. 其全部在下午运行在两个CPU核心上,全部可以使用发布的代码从公共基准文件中重新生成. 数字是团队所计划的预算,按照团队的计算计算。
